description: This file defines a utility enum 'LogLocator' that provides methods for locating and managing log files within a specified directory, primarily for logging purposes related to 'OpenClaw'. It handles environment variable overrides, directory creation, retrieving the latest log file, and providing paths for launchd configurations.

methods.name: logDir
methods.description: Computed property returning the URL to the log directory, using environment variable override if set, otherwise defaulting to '/tmp/openclaw'.

methods.name: stdoutLog
methods.description: Computed property returning the URL for the stdout log file within the log directory.

methods.name: gatewayLog
methods.description: Computed property returning the URL for the gateway log file within the log directory.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Method that ensures the log directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: modificationDate
methods.description: Method that retrieves the content modification date of a given URL, defaulting to distantPast if unavailable.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Public method that returns the latest log file in the log directory, filtering by prefix and extension, and based on modification date.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Computed property returning the path used for launchd stdout/err logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Computed property returning the path used for Gateway launchd job stdout/err logs.
